user.title: OSAZEE BILRESA
user.description: Enable live aborted-multipress events for IKEA BILRESA dual-button Matter remotes. Requires the Matter integration. Historical events are never replayed. On firmware 1.9.15 this identifies at least three presses, not exactly three. Configure actions in the OSAZEE blueprint.

abort.already_configured: The BILRESA bridge is already configured.
